_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
D ak i d-uwanek {player_id} deg Three-Player Tic Tac Toe.
Azamul inek d '{symbol}'.
Tettekkiḍ lawan iɛeddan azamul inek ɣef takarḍa 5x5 i wakken ad teskelsiḍ aɣris n kuẓ.
Iɣrisen zemren ad ilin ufella, ubeqqeḍ, neɣ aɣris aɛewwaḍ.
Sekkelsiḍ iɣewwaṛ inek s tifinaghin '[4]' i wakken ad teskelsiḍ takarḍa 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Asebter n usiweḍ ur yelhi ara. Seqdec "[cell]" anda tazeqqa d 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Uṭṭun n tzelɣa ur nelli ara d win: {cell}. Ilaq ad yili gar 0 akked {max_cell} .
invalid_move.made_invalid: Amyurar {player_id} iga-d amussu ur nlaq ara.
